channel.title: Bay Area Sports Blog
channel.description: Every Bay Area team, argued about properly. The 49ers, Warriors, Giants, A's and Sharks, written by a fan, not a network.

item.title: 49ers All Time Leaders: Passing, Rushing, Receiving and More
item.description: The 49ers all time leaders in passing, rushing, receiving, sacks, interceptions and points, with Purdy, Kittle and Bosa chasing the record book right now.

item.title: Brandon Aiyuk Showed Up. He Still Won't Say He Wants to Be a 49er.
item.description: Brandon Aiyuk met the 49ers with Drew Rosenhaus, wants reinstatement and owes about $13 million in bonus money. A fan on how weird this has gotten.

item.title: 49ers Super Bowl History: Every Appearance and Playoff Run
item.description: How many Super Bowls have the 49ers won? Five in eight tries. Every 49ers Super Bowl, the NFC title games and the full playoff history through 2025.

item.title: Bay Area Retired Numbers: Every Team, Every Jersey
item.description: Every retired number in the Bay Area: the 49ers, Giants, Warriors, Sharks and A's, who wore them, who should be next, and why the Raiders have none.

item.title: Giants Dodgers Rivalry: Head to Head Record and Biggest Moments
item.description: The Giants and Dodgers are six wins apart after more than 2,600 games. The head to head record, 1951, 1982, 1993, 2021 and why a Giants fan never lets go.

item.title: Levi's Stadium Guide: Parking, Transit, Bag Policy and Tips
item.description: A fan's Levi's Stadium guide: parking passes, the clear bag policy, VTA, Caltrain and ACE routes, tailgating rules, and which side of the stadium to avoid.

item.title: SAP Center Guide: Parking, Bag Policy, Doors and Getting There
item.description: Your Sharks game night at SAP Center, hour by hour: Diridon and transit, parking, door times, the bag policy and what you can bring into the Shark Tank.

item.title: Bay Area Sports Are Getting Good Again, and I Can't Stop Smiling
item.description: Bryce Eldridge, Yaxel Lendeborg, Brock Purdy, a pass rush that finally gets home and a hurt rookie I can't quit. Bay Area sports feel young and fun again.

item.title: The Warriors Stopped Paying Kristaps Porzingis, and I Think He's Done
item.description: Zero games this season, leaning toward retirement, and now the Warriors have stopped paying his $20 million salary. Fifteen games is all we ever got.

item.title: 49ers Work Out Eight Defenders, and Five of Them Play Inside
item.description: The 49ers worked out eight free agent defenders on Tuesday, five of them defensive linemen. What the list says about the depth behind Buckner and Osa.

item.title: Five Straight, and I Owe the Warriors an Apology
item.description: Down 17 to Phoenix with Draymond ejected, the Warriors won 116 to 113 for five straight. Ten days ago they were 0 and 3 and I was done with them.

item.title: Mac Jones Trade Rumors: Hang Up the Phone, John
item.description: Mac Jones trade rumors are back with the deadline on November 10. The 49ers are 6 and 1, Purdy is healthy, and the best backup in football should stay put.

item.title: Jauan Jennings Said No to Coming Home. That One Stings.
item.description: The 49ers and Vikings had a Jauan Jennings trade lined up. All he had to do was tell Shanahan and Lynch he wanted back. He said he'd rather stay in Minnesota.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg Is the Truth, and Steph Knows It
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg dropped 37 on the Clippers with Steph and Draymond sitting. Four straight wins, and Curry at 38 finally has a kid who can carry a night.

item.title: Steph Curry Is 38 and He Just Put Luka on the Floor
item.description: Down 25 to the Lakers, Steph Curry dropped Luka Doncic with a crossover, hit the three, and scored 31 in a 112 to 95 comeback. At 38 he's averaging 29.2 a night.

item.title: Garrett Wilson to the 49ers? It's Just the Internet Talking.
item.description: The Garrett Wilson to San Francisco rumors are all noise so far. Buckner was probably the big move. Meanwhile Seattle went and got Quenton Nelson.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg Is My Rookie of the Year, and Ten Teams Should Be Sick
item.description: The Warriors took Yaxel Lendeborg 11th and ten teams passed. Five games in he's at 22.6 points and 9.2 rebounds, and he looks built to play next to Steph Curry.

item.title: They Cut Jack Jones. DeForest Buckner Needed the Spot.
item.description: The 49ers released Jack Jones on Wednesday so DeForest Buckner has a roster spot. Seven games, a benching in Atlanta, and a corner room that just got thinner.

item.title: He's Home. DeForest Buckner Is a 49er Again, and the Front Just Changed.
item.description: The 49ers got DeForest Buckner back for a 2027 fourth. Four sacks, a bye week to install him, and the middle of this defensive line finally has a grown man.

item.title: 0-3, and Yaxel Lendeborg Is Why I'm Still Smiling
item.description: The Warriors are 0-3 after the Lakers, Grizzlies and Suns. Yaxel Lendeborg is at 18.7 points, 8.3 rebounds and 4.3 assists, and that's why I'm smiling.

item.title: Oh and Two, and This Is What the Warriors Front Office Bought
item.description: Three star chases, zero trades, and a roster pinned under the second apron. The oh and two start is the bill for a summer that wasted another Curry year.

item.title: Six and Oh, Barely. The '72 Dolphins Should Be Sweating.
item.description: The 49ers held off Washington 23 to 17 on Monday night to go 6 and 0. Purdy took the career passer rating crown, and the '72 Dolphins have company to worry about.

item.title: Malik Mustapha Is a Heat Seeking Missile. Learn His Name.
item.description: A fourth round pick from the Trey Lance trade, two ACL repairs, and back to back game saving plays. Malik Mustapha is the 49ers' poor man's Ronnie Lott.

item.title: Bring DeForest Buckner Home. The 49ers Will Never Get a Better Shot.
item.description: The Colts fired their GM, Buckner is fed up at 2 and 4, and the 49ers have $41 million in cap space and a banged up defensive line. Go get Big Buck back.

item.title: Nick Bosa Is Out Monday Night. Juice and Evans Might Not Be.
item.description: The 49ers ruled Nick Bosa out for Monday night against Washington. Kyle Juszczyk has no tag, and Mike Evans is questionable with ribs and an Achilles.

item.title: Christian Kirk Finally Practiced, and Mike Evans Didn't
item.description: Christian Kirk practiced for the first time since July. Mike Evans sat with two broken ribs and a sore Achilles. Monday night at Levi's is next.

item.title: Jauan Jennings Trade Rumors: Bring Him Home, 49ers
item.description: Deebo's hamstring is gone, the receiver room is on IR, and Jauan Jennings has two catches in Minnesota. The 49ers trade rumors make too much sense to ignore.

item.title: 49ers 5 and 0 Through All the Injuries: Shanahan's Best Job Yet
item.description: Bosa out, the line gutted, the coach in a July car wreck, and the 49ers are 5 and 0. Only the 1999 Rams also beat three 12 win teams in a 5 and 0 start.

item.title: Dre Greenlaw Suspended One Game for the Head Butt in Seattle
item.description: The NFL suspended Dre Greenlaw one game without pay for head butting Ernest Jones, so he misses Washington. A Niners fan on the appeal, Dugger and the pattern.

item.title: 49ers Beat Seahawks 32 to 29 in Seattle and Go 5 and 0
item.description: Seven turnovers, a Greenlaw ejection, Deebo hurt and the 12th man screaming, and the 49ers still beat the champs 32 to 29 at Lumen Field. A Niners fan exhales.

item.title: 49ers Cut Matt Judon and Activate Mykel Williams for Seattle
item.description: The 49ers released Matt Judon and activated Mykel Williams off PUP. Number 98 plays Sunday at Seattle, his first game since the ACL. A Niners fan on why it matters.

item.title: 49ers vs Seahawks Preview: Win in Seattle and the NFC West Is Ours
item.description: 49ers vs Seahawks Week 5 preview from a Niners fan: 4 and 0, Purdy still unsacked, Bosa out, Seattle favored by 3, and why a win at Lumen Field puts us in control.

item.title: Cowherd Calls Brock Purdy the Best QB Ever. Don't Jinx Seattle.
item.description: Colin Cowherd once picked the 49ers third in the West. Now he calls Brock Purdy the best quarterback ever, right before the passer rating record falls in Seattle.

item.title: 49ers 24, Broncos 14: Greenlaw Gets His Revenge and We're 4 and 0
item.description: 49ers beat the Broncos 24 to 14 at Levi's to go 4 and 0. Greenlaw's 12 tackles against his old team, Kittle's dagger, zero sacks again, and Juszczyk's knee.

item.title: The 49ers Are the Team to Beat in the NFC, and It's Not Close
item.description: One penalty for 5 yards, zero sacks allowed in four games, one Purdy pick all year. Why Shanahan's 4 and 0 Niners are the team to beat in the NFC.

item.title: Juszczyk Out 2 to 3 Weeks and It Hits Us Hard in Seattle
item.description: Kyle Juszczyk's knee sprain has him out two to three weeks, so the 49ers go to Seattle without the guy who makes all that backfield motion work. He'll be missed.

item.title: John Lynch Deserves Credit for This 49ers Pass Rush
item.description: The guys who pressured Bo Nix came from a sixth round swap, a third round trade, a trade down and the practice squad. A Niners fan gives John Lynch his due.

item.title: 49ers Offense: McCaffrey, Juszczyk and Watkins Keep the Points Coming
item.description: Half the 49ers receiver room is hurt and they still scored 98 points in three games. McCaffrey, Kyle Juszczyk and Jordan Watkins, from a Niners fan.

item.title: Brock Purdy Is the Best Quarterback in the NFL. Check the Numbers.
item.description: Brock Purdy has the best career passer rating of any active QB and leads the league at 133.1. The Shanahan and weapons excuses are nonsense. A Niners fan's case.

item.title: Jed York Suspended Six Games and Fined $500,000 by the NFL
item.description: The NFL suspended 49ers owner Jed York six games and fined him $500,000 after his Ohio arrest. A Niners fan on why the punishment feels like a shrug.
